cases.sentence: Род Данитян искал себе ___, чтобы поселиться там.
cases.translation: The tribe of Dan sought an inheritance of land to dwell in.
cases.explain: Землю is the direct object of the transitive verb искал (sought), taking the accusative case.

cases.sentence: И донитяне послали пятерых храбрецов из Цоры и Эштаола, чтобы разведать ___ и исследовать ее.
cases.translation: The Danites sent five valiant men from Zorah and Eshtaol to spy out the land and search it.
cases.explain: Землю is the direct object of the transitive verb разведать (to spy out), taking the accusative case.

cases.sentence: Когда они пришли в Нагорье Ефрема, к дому Михи, они заночевали там, и, будучи поблизости, узнали голос молодого ___.
cases.translation: When they came to the hill country of Ephraim, to the house of Micah, they lodged there, and knowing the voice of the young Levite.
cases.explain: The direct object of узнали (recognized) takes the accusative levita.

cases.sentence: Тогда они сказали ему: «Пожалуйста, спроси у ___, чтобы нам знать, будет ли наше путешествие успешным».
cases.translation: 'Please ask God whether our journey will be prosperous.'
cases.explain: The preposition у (of) governing 'ask of' takes the genitive case Бога.

cases.sentence: Они жили далеко от ___ и ни с кем не были в союзе.
cases.translation: They lived far from Sidon and had no dealings with anyone else.
cases.explain: The preposition от (from) takes the genitive case Сидона.

cases.sentence: Они ответили: «Пойдемте, нападем на ___. Мы увидели, что эта земля очень хороша».
cases.translation: 'Come, let's attack them. We have seen that the land is very good.'
cases.explain: The transitive verb нападем (attack) takes the accusative case их (them).

cases.sentence: Мы увидели, что эта ___ очень хороша.
cases.translation: We have seen that the land is very good.
cases.explain: Земля is the grammatical subject of the predicate adjective хороша (is good), standing in nominative case.

cases.sentence: Когда они пришли к Лаишу, они напали на мирный и беспечный ___.
cases.translation: When they came to Laish, they attacked a peaceful and unsuspecting people.
cases.explain: Народ is the direct object of the transitive verb напали (attacked), taking the accusative case.

reading.ru: В те дни у Израиля не было царя. Род Данитян искал себе землю, чтобы поселиться там, потому что до этого времени земля между родами Израиля еще не была ему отведена.
reading.question: Why did the tribe of Dan seek land to settle?
options: Because they had not yet been allotted an inheritance among the tribes of Israel
Because their land had been taken by the Philistines
Because they wanted to expand their territory
Because the king ordered them to migrate
reading.correct: Because they had not yet been allotted an inheritance among the tribes of Israel
reading.explain: The text states: земля между родами Израиля еще не была ему отведена — an inheritance had not been given to them among the tribes of Israel.

reading.ru: Эти люди представляли все их кланы. Им сказали, «Идите, исследуйте землю».
reading.question: What task were the five men sent to do?
options: To go and explore the land
To build a settlement in Laish
To recruit more soldiers for battle
reading.correct: To go and explore the land
reading.explain: They were told: Идите, исследуйте землю — Go, explore the land.

reading.ru: Когда они пришли в Нагорье Ефрема, к дому Михи, они заночевали там, и, будучи поблизости, узнали голос молодого левита.
reading.question: How did the five spies recognize the Levite?
options: They saw him working in Micah's house
A messenger told them about him
They found written records about him
reading.explain: The text says: узнали голос молодого левита — they recognized the voice of the young Levite.

reading.ru: Эти пятеро ушли и пришли в Лаиш, там они увидели, что народ живет спокойно, по обычаю седанян, тихо и беспечно, не нуждаясь ни в чем на земле и обладая богатством.
reading.question: What did the spies observe about the people of Laish?
options: They lived peacefully, quietly and securely, lacking nothing and possessing wealth
They were in constant conflict with their neighbors
They were militarily powerful and well-armed
They were ruled by a powerful king
reading.correct: They lived peacefully, quietly and securely, lacking nothing and possessing wealth
reading.explain: The spies saw: народ живет спокойно ... тихо и беспечно, не нуждаясь ни в чем и обладая богатством — the people lived peacefully, quietly and securely, lacking nothing and possessing wealth.

reading.ru: Они пришли к своим сородичам в Цору и Эштаол и сказали: «Пойдемте, нападем на них. Мы увидели, что эта земля очень хороша».
reading.question: What recommendation did the five spies make to their kinsmen?
options: Attack the people of Laish because the land is very good
Send more scouts to gather additional information
Ask the king for permission to settle there
Move to a different region that is safer
reading.correct: Attack the people of Laish because the land is very good
reading.explain: They said: Пойдемте, нападем на них ... эта земля очень хороша — Let's go attack them, for the land is very good.

reading.ru: Они назвали его Дан, в честь своего предка Дана, который родился у Израиля, хотя прежде город назывался Лаиш.
reading.question: Why did the Danites rename the city Laish?
options: They named it Dan after their ancestor Dan who was born to Israel
They wanted to honor the Sidonians who formerly occupied it
They named it after their leader
reading.correct: They named it Dan after their ancestor Dan who was born to Israel
reading.explain: The text states: Они назвали его Дан, в честь своего предка Дана, который родился у Израиля — They called it Dan, after the name of Dan their father, who was born to Israel.
